title: GL-04 — Customer-managed KMS key
stopChargesPanel: Delete S3 object and bucket first, then alias, then let scheduled key deletion continue.

steps.title: Set the profile and region
bullets: In PowerShell run `$env:AWS_PROFILE = 'your-lab-profile'` using a named profile, not root.
Run `$env:AWS_REGION = 'us-east-1'`.
Success: both variables print the expected values.

steps.title: Confirm who is signed in
bullets: Run `aws sts get-caller-identity`.
Success: Arn contains `:user/` or `:assumed-role/`, not `:root`.
Set `$AccountId` from the Account field.

steps.title: Confirm AWS CLI v2
bullets: Run `aws --version`.
Success: output starts with `aws-cli/2`.
This lab focuses on KMS; Terraform is not required unless a step says so.

steps.title: Read the cost estimate
bullets: Open this lab's same-hour and forgotten-24h estimates in the card header.
Success: you can state both numbers before creating billable resources.
Budget alerts from GL-01 warn only; they do not stop spend.

steps.title: Set lab variables
bullets: Set `$CreatedAt` and `$ExpiresAt` to today's calendar date.
Success: date variables and lab names are set.

steps.title: Create the CMK
bullets: Run `aws kms create-key --description 'workbook gl-04' --tags Key=Workbook,Value=aws-tf-lab Key=LabId,Value=gl-04 Key=CreatedAt,Value=$CreatedAt Key=ExpiresAt,Value=$ExpiresAt`
Set `$KeyId` from KeyMetadata.KeyId in the output.
Run `aws kms create-alias --alias-name alias/workbook-gl04 --target-key-id $KeyId`.
Success: describe-key returns your key.

steps.title: Create the lab bucket
bullets: Set `$Bucket = "workbook-gl04-$AccountId"`.
Run `aws s3api create-bucket --bucket $Bucket --region us-east-1`.
Run `aws s3api put-bucket-tagging --bucket $Bucket --tagging "TagSet=[{Key=LabId,Value=gl-04},{Key=Workbook,Value=aws-tf-lab}]"`.
Success: head-bucket succeeds.

steps.title: Encrypt an object
bullets: Run `'secret-gl04' | Out-File -Encoding ascii gl04.txt`.
Run `aws s3 cp gl04.txt s3://$Bucket/secret.txt --sse aws:kms --sse-kms-key-id $KeyId`.
Success: head-object shows SSEKMSKeyId.

steps.title: Decrypt the object
bullets: Run `aws s3 cp s3://$Bucket/secret.txt -`.
Success: plaintext prints.

steps.title: Schedule key deletion
bullets: Run `aws kms schedule-key-deletion --key-id $KeyId --pending-window-in-days 7`.
Success: DeletionDate is set. Do not cancel during this lab.

steps.title: Confirm alias
bullets: Run `aws kms list-aliases --query "Aliases[?AliasName=='alias/workbook-gl04']"`.
Success: alias targets `$KeyId`.

steps.title: Cost checkpoint
bullets: Re-read the same-hour and forgotten-24h estimates on this lab card.
Stopping an instance or scaling to zero is not teardown.
Success: you know what still bills if you walk away overnight.

steps.title: Order the deletes
bullets: Teardown order for this lab: S3 object and bucket, then delete alias; leave key in pending deletion
Open Stop charges and read each PowerShell line top to bottom.
Success: dependents are deleted before parents.

steps.title: Tear the lab down
bullets: Run every Stop charges command yourself in order.
Success: `aws resourcegroupstaggingapi get-resources --tag-filters Key=LabId,Values=gl-04` returns an empty ResourceTagMappingList.

steps.title: Check the bill later
bullets: After 8–12 hours, review today's charges in the Billing console.
Record actual spend in your notes.
CMK pending deletion may still appear until the waiting period ends.

hints: Use official AWS docs for exact flags.

orderedDeletesPowerShell: # Key remains scheduled for deletion; do not cancel
verification: aws resourcegroupstaggingapi get-resources --tag-filters Key=LabId,Values=gl-04 returns an empty ResourceTagMappingList in $env:AWS_REGION
teardown.stillBillingNote: Time already used, transfer, tax, and 8–12h billing lag may still appear. Alerts do not delete resources. CMK in pending deletion may still appear on bill until window ends.
teardown.recovery: If teardown fails, stop. Confirm $env:AWS_REGION is us-east-1 and the caller is not root. Run aws sts get-caller-identity and type that Account value before any delete. List LabId=gl-04 with aws resourcegroupstaggingapi get-resources --tag-filters Key=LabId,Values=gl-04. Delete only those ids. Never delete untagged resources.

body: Create a symmetric CMK, encrypt one S3 object with SSE-KMS, read it back, then schedule key deletion (7-day window). Do not cancel scheduled deletion.
